tei:div.tei:p: (32)༄༅// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// sngon 'gro la/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las// thun mong la/ dal 'byor rnyed pa dka' ba/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom pa bzhi las/ dang po la dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba la/ rgyu'i sgo nas/ ngo bo'i sgo nas/ grangs kyi sgo nas/ dpe'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba bzhi las/ rgyu'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba ni/ rgyu tshul khrims bsrungs pa las/ 'bras bu mi lus thob pa yin la tshul khrims ni mi dge ba bcu 'khor bcas spong ba'i sems pa ste/ spong ba'i sems ni thob pa las// tshul khrims pha rol phyin par bshad/ ces gsungs so// de spong mkhan ches nyung bas 'bras bu mi lus rnyed par dka' ba'o// de yang rje btsun gyis/ dal 'byor mi lus mi dkon du/ tshul khrims srung ba'i mi re nyung*/ zhes gsungs so// ngo bo'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba ni/ dal ba brgyad tshang ba rnyed par dka' ste/ mi (33)khoms pa'i gnas brgyad du skye ba ches sla bas so// de yang mi khoms pa brgyad ni/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*// kla klo tshe ring lha dang ni// log lta sangs rgyas kyis stongs pa// lkugs pa 'di dag mi khom brgyad/ ces pa'i dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro gsum sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba dang*/ kla klo ste grub mtha'i dbang du byas pa stag gzig pa la sogs pa dang*/ yul gyi dbang du byas pa mtha' 'khob pa rnams ni mi'i gzugs su snang yang*/ dud 'gro ltar bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa mi shes pa dang*/ lha ni bag med pas dang*/ log par lta ba ni bsam pa phyin ci log tu gyur pas dang*/ sangs rgyas kyis stongs pa'i 'jig rten ni mun pa'i bskal pa dang*/ gling bar lta bur skyes pa ston pa'i snang ba med pa dang*/ lkugs pa ni yid kyi dbang po ma tshang ba legs nyes mi shes pas dam pa'i chos nyan par mi khoms pa zhes bya'o// 'byor pa dang ldan pa rnyed par dka' ste/

yul gyi dbus su mir skyes shing*// dbang po (34)tshang zhing chos la dad// las mtha' ma log mtha' ru phyin// 'di lnga rang gi 'byor pa yin/ yul gyi dbus sas brtsis pa rgya gar rdo rje gdan la sogs pa'i yul/ chos kyis brtsis pa ston pa'i bstan pa rnam par dag pa gang du yod pa/ 'di dang phyi mar mir skyes pa/ dbang po sgo drug tshang ba/ chos la dad pa/ las kyi mtha' ma log pa ni mtshams med pa lnga gang yang rung ba ma byas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas byon dang des chos gsungs// bstan pa gnas dang de rjes 'jug /gzhan gyi phyir na de snying rje ba/ 'di lnga gzhan gyi 'byor pa yin/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa/ des chos gsungs pa/ bstan pa gnas pa/ bstan pa la zhugs pa/ chos byed pa'i mthun rkyen tshogs pa ste/ de lta bu'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i mi lus la/ rnyed par dka' ba sogs yon tan drug chos mthun du yod pas rin po che zhes bya'o// de yang sems can thams cad kyis rang gi ma ma byas pa med la/ de re res ma byas pa'i grangs kyang*/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshi gu tsam/ ril bur byas kyang sa yis langs mi 'gyur/ zhes gsungs so// de lta bu'i lus ji snyed cig blangs kyang dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob pa da res tsam/ da lan 'dis gtan gyi don ma grub na/ da dung lus ci tsam zhig len bar byed kyang*/ dal 'byor gyi lus ni de dag tu shin tu rnyed par dka' ba ste/ spyod 'jug las/ dal 'byor 'di ni rnyed par shin tu dka'/ skyes bus don grub thob par gyur pa la/ gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrubs na/ phyis 'di yang dag 'byor par gal 'gyur/ zhes dang*/ mi yi gru la brten nas ni// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho che (35)las sgrol// gru 'di phyis nas rnyed dka' bas// rmongs pa dus 'dir gnyid ma log /ces gsungs so/// /grangs kyi sgo nas rnyed dka' ba ni/ ngan song gsum du skyes pa ches mang zhing*/

mtho ris su skyes pa ni nyung*/ de'i nang nas kyang dal 'byor kyi mi lus ni shin tu nyung bas/ rje btsun gyis/ dal 'byor mi lus dkon gsungs te// khyod 'dra mthong na dkon rgyu med/ ces khyi ra bar gsungs pa bzhin no// dper bgyis na/ thang lag mthil tsam na srog chags grogs sbur ji snyed yod la/ grog ma'i tshang re re la yang bgrang du med pa tsam yod na/ dung pa gang gi mi la de ltar min pas shes par bya'o// de yang mdo las/ sa rdo ri klung thams cad dud 'gros khengs gyur na// ngan 'gro gzhan gyi tshad ni su yis shes// zhes so// dpe'i sgo nas rnyed dka' ba ni/ rgya mtsho cher g.yengs gnya' shing gi /bu gar rus sbal mgrin tshud ltar/ mi nyid shin tu rnyed par dka'/ zhes dang*/ mngal 'jug las/ khab mig nam mkha' la phyar nas yungs kar spar mo gang gtor na khab mig gi nang du yungs kar tshud pa ni srid la/ mi yi lus ni shin tu rnyed par dka'o// zhes gsungs so/ de ltar rnyed par dka' ba'i mi lus rin po che thob nas chos ma byas na rang gis rang bslus pa yin pas snying thag pa nas dam pa'i chos bya'o// de yang*/ chos rjes/ mi lus thob nas chos med po/ gser gling phyin nas stong log mkhan/ ngang ngan song lhung na mi 'gyod dam/ mi dad med rnams la 'phrin de skyol/ zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom pa la/ skyes kyi rting la nges par 'chi ba/ nam 'chi cha med/ 'chi ba'i rkyen mang (36)ra bstan pa/ cis kyang mi stongs par 'chi ba bsam pa'o// skyes kyi rting la nges par 'chi ba bsam pa ni/ skyes nas skad cig kyang sdod long med par 'chi bdag gi mdun du rgyug pa ste/ dam pas/ skyes pa'i nang par 'chi ba'i bya byung bas/ long med rgyud la khol cig ding ri ba/ zhes gsungs so// dper na gsod sar khrid pa'i dud 'gro gom pa re re dor gyin 'chi ba la nyer 'gro ba bzhin no// rje btsun gyis/

tshe 'di mi rtag nyi rgas grib so 'dra/ phar phar phyin kyang tshur tshur 'ong*/ bros pas thar ba ngas ma mthong*/ lo dang zla ba'i char pas brdung*/ zhag dang za ma'i thigs pa bab/ sgyu lus kyi khang pa 'gyel la khad/ 'chi brod kyi thig tshags byed re ran/ zhes gsungs so// gzhan yang rgyu rkyen las skyes pa'i chos yin phan chad skad cig ma gnyis su sdod pa'i long med par 'jig pas na 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa zhes bya'o// dpa' bos/ 'di ltar thams cad skye ba yi/ mdun na gnas pa 'chi ba ste/ zhes gsungs so// nam 'chi cha med bsam pa ni/ lus can rnams kyi khrod na/ 'di sngon la 'chi/ 'di rjes su 'chi zhes ris su bcad pa ci yang med la/ mi 'chi la re ba zhig thog rgyab tu 'chi yis 'dug pa ltar rang la yang 'byung bas/ rje btsun gyis/ khyod gzhon pa pho mo 'tshogs tsa na/ 'chi ba yod snyam mi gda' ste// 'chi ba thog babs kyi tshul du yong gin gda'/ zhes so// de tsam du ma zad do nub glo bur du gza' la sogs pa gdon nam/ g.yang la lhung ba'am/ gtibs 'og tu tshud pa'am/ nad kyis sam/ mtshon gyis 'chi bar mi 'gyur ba'i gding su la yang med la/ do nub mi 'chi ba'i thag chod pa med pa bzhin du de (37)ring 'di bya/ sang 'di byed/ da gzod la sogs pa'i bya gzhag gi phyi tshis dang gsog 'jog sgrub pa ni rang gis rang bslus pa kho nar zad de/ rgyal sras thogs med pas/ de ring tsam yang mi 'chi'i gding med la// rtag tu sdod grabs byed pa'i ngang ring po// 'chi kar brang lag 'thab mo 'chor nyen gda'/ 'chi ba rjes su dran par byin gyis rlobs/ zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug tu/ de ring kho nar mi 'chi zhes/ bde bar 'dug pa'i rigs ma yin/ zhes dang*/ slob spring las/ 'di ni sad bya 'di ni thang cig 'og tu bya/ 'di ni de ring bya zhes skye bo sems pa na/ gshin rje be con lag thogs zur gyis lta ba yi/

mig rtsa dmar khros ma rangs gad mo re snyam 'debs/ zhes gsungs so// 'chi ba'i rkyen mang bar bstan pa ni/ lus can rnams kyi tshe gnod pa 'ba' zhig gi nang du gnas pa rlung gis btab pa'i chu'i lbu ba lta bur da lta ma yal bar 'dug kyang*/ ring du gnas par bya ba'i nus pa med pas yid brtan du rung ba ma yin te/ klu sgrub kyis/ tshe 'di gnod mang rlung gis btab pa yi// chu yi chu bur bas kyang mi rtag na// dbugs dbyung dbugs rngub gnyid kyis log pa las// sad khoms gang lags de ni ngo mtshar che/ zhes gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang*/ skyes pa'i tha ma ni 'chi/ 'dus pa 'bral/ bsags pa 'dzad/ brtsigs pa 'gyel bas gang la yang snying po med par bsam zhing*/ nad drag po dbugs chad la khad khad pa byung tshe/ nor gyis blur med/ mdzangs pa dang*/ gzugs byad mdzes pa dang*/ dpa' zhing brtul phod pa dang*/ mnga' thang dang*/ sa mkhar dang*/ gnyen gyis (38)ci byar med par/ gcig pur ga shed du sgren mo lag stong du 'gro// bar do'i 'jigs pa ni dran/ tshe phyi ma gar 'gro ni med/ 'dir mi phan par na par bzung bas ni nongs// dus de'i tshe chos med ba'i 'gyod pa drag po/ skyid pa'i rgyal po nas sdug pa'i ya gshan gyi par thams cad la 'byung gi 'dug pa la bsams kyang*/ dam pa'i chos la 'bad rigs te// mgo'am gos la glo bur me shor na/ de dag phyir bzlog bgyi ba btang nas kyang*/ yang srid med bgyi'i slad du 'bad 'tshal te/ 'di bas ches mchog dgos pa gzhan ma mchis/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin no// cis kyang mi stong par 'chi ba bsam pa ni/ 'chi bas mi tshugs pa'i sa phyogs ni gang du'ang yod pa ma yin te/ dpa' bos/ sa'am 'on te mtho ris na/ skyes nas la la ma shi ba/ 'ga' zhig khyod kyis mthong ba'am/ thos sam 'on te the tshom za/ zhes dang*/ yang drang srong chen po lnga mngon shes/ mkha' la rgyang ring 'gro ba yang*/ gang na spyod yul 'chi med pa/

der ni 'gro bar nus pa med/ ces gsungs shing*/ sra ba'i lhun po'ang thal bcom du ma lus par 'jig cing*/ rgya mtsho chen po zab pa yang skem par 'gyur na/ lus can gyi lus nyams chung ba ci'i phyir mi 'jig ste/ de nyid kyis gang du sa rnams bsregs gyur pas/ lhun po thal bar 'jig pa dang*/ rgya mtsho'i chu yang bskam 'gyur na/ lus can de dag lta ci smos/ zhes so// da dung ma 'chi bsam na ci'i phyir mi 'chi ste/ rang gi spyi bo'i skra nas rkang mthil gyi bar thams cad la zhib mor brtags na/ ci bas nyam thag pa/ nyam chung ba/ mi gtsang ba/ rtag ba'i rang bzhin ci yang med pas/ 'di la gtsang bar (39)bzung*/ rtag par bltas/ bdag tu zhen pa sngon chad rang 'khrul pas bslus pa 'ba' zhig tu zad la/ sangs rgyas kyi sku rdo rje lta bu yang zhig na/ nga'i lus snying po med pa 'di ci'i phyir mi 'jig ces bsam par bya ste// ci ste sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku// mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa// rdo rje'i sku yang mi rtag na// chu shing snying po med 'dra ba'i// lus can gzhan dag smos ci dgos/ zhes gsungs so/// /gsum pa las rgyu 'bras bsam pa ni/ bsam sbyor gnyis ka dge bas byas pa gcig tu dkar pa'i las/ bsam sbyor gnyis ka mi dge ba gcig tu gnag pa'i las/ bsam sbyor gang rung gcig dge gzhan mi dge na 'dres pa'i las/ dang po la ni rnam smin bde ba 'ba' zhig pa dang*/ gnyis pa la ni rnam smin sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig pa dang*/ gsum pa la ni bde sdug 'dres par 'byung la/ de yang stobs che ba cho 'di la smin pa mthong ba'i chos la myong bar 'gyur ba'i las dang*/ skye ba rting mar 'byung ba phyi mar myong ba/ skye ba mang po brgyud nas smin pa lan grangs gzhan la myong bar 'gyur pa ste/ de ltar rang gis byas shing bsags pa'i las ni rang nyid kyi phung po 'ba' zhig la smin par 'gyur bas/ sdig to mi dge pa'i phyogs rnams ni chung ngu yin yang spang la/

dge ba'i rtsa ba ni chung ngu chung ngu yin kyang bskyed par bya ste/ dug chung ngus mi chen po gsod pa dang*/ sman chung dus nad chen po 'joms pa'i dpe shes par bya zhing*/ lus can rnams kyi skyid sdug logs nyes thams cad bsam pa'i rjes su mi 'gro /las kyi rjes su 'gro bas so// jo bo rjes/ bsams tshad thog tu mi khel// pha rol las las grub pas// lhod kyis glod na bde'o// zhes (40)dang*/ gzhan las/ las ni grib ma bzhin du phyi bzhin 'brang*// mi tsho phal cher sdig pa'i las la zad// phyi ma'i 'gro sa ngan song kho na yin/ zhes dang*/ las brgya las/ lus can dag gi las rnams ni// bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za// tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ 'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ zhes dang*/ phan pa'i 'bras bu bde ba che// gnod ba'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung*/ zhes dang*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ zhes so/// /bzhi pa 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom pa ni/ dran pa nyer bzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams// yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams// dud 'gro gcig las gcig zas nyams// mi dag 'tsho ba thung bas nyams// lha dag bag med pa yis nyams/ zhes gsungs pa/ sems can dmyal ba la ni las las skyes pa'i gshin rjes 'jigs su rung ba'i mtshon chas yang btags shing yang sos pa gang sos/ thig nag po btab nas de sog les gtub pa thig nag /lcags kyi ri lug la sogs pa'i gdeng 'dra ba'i bar du 'thag pa bsdus 'joms/ gsal shing 'bar ba rtse mo gcig pas spyi bo nas thal byung du 'bugs pa ngu 'bod/ gsal shing rtse mo gsum pas 'bigs pa ngu 'bod chen po// lus me lce'i phreng bas sreg pa tsha ba/ khro chu khol mar 'tshed pa rab tu tsha ba/ lus sreg pa dang*/ lcags kyi gzer bus go mtshams med par sdams pa dang*/

lce la rmon dor lnga brgyas rmod pa sogs sdug bsngal drag pos mnar bas med de/ yun/ yang sos la sogs drug rim bzhin/(41)'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam// des na de dag rnams kyi tshe// 'dod lha'i tshe dang mnyam pa yin// rab tu tsha phyed mnar med ni// bar gyi bskal pa'o// zhes gsungs so// gzhan yang*/ chu bo rab med du nub pa dang*/ lo ma ral gri'i nags tshal dang*/ tsher ma rnon po'i tshal dang*/ slu gris gtams pa'i so dang*/ rim pa med par 'gro ba dang*/ lcags kyi tho lum 'bar ba za ba dang*/ khro chu 'thung ba dang*/ sa gzhi rab tu 'bar bar 'dug pa dang*/ yongs su bsgyur zhing 'bros pa dang*/ brgyal ba dang*/ smre ba la sogs pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i gzugs du mas sdug bsngal brgya phrag mang po myong ngo*/ grang ba'i dmyal ba/ chu bur can dang*/ chu bur brdol ba can dang*/ a chu zer ba dang*/ kyi hud zer ba dang*/ so tham tham pa dang*/ u tpal ltar gas pa/ padma ltar gas pa dang*/ padma ltar cher gas pa ste/ shin tu grang ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzod pa dang*/ ral gri rnon po thogs pa'i gshin rje gtum pos brdeg cing gtums pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal myong ba yang*/ til rdzong nang nas lo brgya bzhin// til re phyung nas zad gyur pa// chu bur can gyi tshe yin te// gzhan gyi tshe ni nyi shu bsgyur/ zhes pa'i bar du'o// gzhan yang*/ nyi tshe ba dang nye 'khor ba ste bco brgyad do// yi dwags ni/ lus me 'bar ba/ nang khrol gyis stongs pa'i sgal pa ri'i khrod lta bu/ g.yo ba dang bral ba/ kha khab kyi mig ltar phra ba/ skra rtsub cing gyen du brdzes pa dang*/ kha cig sdong du ma mes reg dang*// 'ga' zhig phyags shel lta bu la sogs pa'i gzugs rnam pa sna tshogs/ zas skom gyi ming tsam yang mi thos pa dang*/ ngan skyugs zab dang*/ zas blo chur gyur nas lus sreg pa la sogs pa (42)ste/ bshes spring las/ yi dwags rnams la sos ka'i dus su ni// zla ba'ang tshal dgun ni nyi ma'ang grab// ljon shing 'bras bu med 'gyur de dag gis// bltas pa tsam gyis chu klung bskam par 'gyur/

zhes dang*/ kha cig kha ni khab kyi mig tsam la/ lto ba ri yi ljongs tsam bkres pas nyen// mi gtsang gyi nar bor ba cung zad tsam/ 'tshal ba'i mthu dang ldan pa ma lags so// zhes dang*/ tshe tshad ni/ zla ba nyin zhag gis lnga brgya/ zhes dang*/ lnga stong dag dang khrir yang 'chi mi 'gyur/ zhes gsungs so// dud 'gro ni glen zhing rmongs pa dang*/ gcig la gcig za ba dang*/ gsod pa dang*/ bkol spyod la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal bgrang du med pa ste/ kha cig mu tig bal dang rus pa khrag sha dang pags pa'i ched du 'chi bar 'gyur/ dbang med gzhan dag lag pa rdog pa dang*/ lcags dang lcags kyu btab pas btab ste bkol/ zhes gsungs so// mi la skye rga na 'chi/ lha la 'chi 'pho ltung byed kyi sdug bsngal yod pa de rnams la ni sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal zhes bya'o// 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ni mtho ris kyi bde ba thams cad de bshes spring las/ brgya byin 'jig rten mchod 'os gyur nas su/ las kyi dbar gis slar yang sa stengs lhung*/ zhes dang*/ tshangs nyid chags bral bde ba skyes nas kyang*/ las kyi dbang gis yang bran nyid du 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pas so// 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga ste/ byis pa lag mthil dang 'dra bas sdug bsngal du ma mthong la 'phags pa mig dang 'dra bas sdug bsngal du gzigs pa'o// de yang*/ byis pa lag mthil 'dra ba yis/ 'du byed sdug bsngal spu mi rtog /'phags pa mig dang 'dra ba (43)yis// de yis de nyid yid kyang 'byung*/ zhes dang*/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ 'khor ba skyid med kyi btson ra na// skyid du re nas sdug bsngal spyod// yun ring gi nad pa gcong can bzhin// bskyangs bskyangs nas 'chi ba yi re mug /ces gsungs pa bzhin khams gsum 'khor ba thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin pas/ zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba zhes bya la/ gtan du bde ba ni mya ngan las 'das pa gcig pu yin pas/

mya ngan las 'das pa 'ba' zhig zhi zhing bde ba'o/// /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la/ rgyud snod du rung bar byed pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi khrid/ 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas/ tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇḍal// byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dang bzhi las/ dang po rgyud snod du rung bar byed pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi khrid ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar/ laṃ las gser gyis gzhi khod snyoms pa'i dbus su/ baṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/ de'i dbus su paṃ las dpag bsam gyi shing blta na chog mi shes pa'i dbus su/ rin po che'i khri la rtsa ba'i bla ma la brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba/ mdun du yi dam 'khor lo sdom pa la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba/ g.yas su sangs rgyas thub pa la sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ rgyab tu yum chen mo la dam pa'i chos po ti dang glegs bam gyi rnam par bzhugs pa/ g.yon du byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs la byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun chen pos bskor ba/ phyogs mtshams thams cad dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma dam pa chos (44)skyod ba'i srung ma thams cad sprin gtibs pa bzhin du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ sems can thams cad kyi ched du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa'i smon pa'i blos/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*/ zhes sogs kyis skyabs 'gro lan gsum sngon du btang nas/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ la sogs pa sngags kyi gzhung las gsungs pa'i cho ga lan gsum gyis byang chub tu sems bskyed la/ rang gi lus kyi bkod pa grangs med cing brjod du med par sprul te/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o// de bzhin du/

bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la= bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la= bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la zhes pas phyag stong phrag gcig btsal nas/ yid kyis kun tu dmigs la/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ zhes bya ba la sogs pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i smon lam gyi cho gas phyag btsal ba la sogs pa yan lag bdun gyi tshul du mchod pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod do// de'i rjes mdun gyi yi dam nas g.yas bskor du thim pa dbus kyi bla ma gtso 'khor la thim zhing 'khor rnams bla ma dang*/ de bdag la bstim/ bsngo ba smon lam bya'o/// /gnyis pa 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyi khrid ni/ rang gi spyi bor paṃ las padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal (45)gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyams ma dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ de las 'od 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i mthar/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra sa twa twe no pa tiṣṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha ba/ su to ṣyo me bha ba/ su po ṣyo me bha ba/

a nu rakto me bha ba/ sarba siddhi mme pra ya tstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsittaṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga bān sarba ta thā ga ta badzra mā me muñtsa/ badzrī bha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥces pas bskor ba/ de las bdud rtsi byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun babs/ yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas thon/ spyi bo na tshangs pa'i bu ga nas lus kyi phyir song ba rnams kyis dri ma dwang*/ nang du song ba rnams kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dud khu dang sol khu/ gdon bgegs thams cad sdig sprul sbal lcong gi rnam par dbang po'i sgo/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas thon nas lus thams cad shel gong dri ma med pa lta bur dwangs ba/ byang chub sems kyis gang bar bsam la yig brgya ci rigs par bzlas nas/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ sku gsung (46)thugs rtsa ba yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje sems dpas rigs kyi bu khyod kyi nyes ltung thams cad dag pa yin no// zhes gnang ba byin rang la thim par bsam mo/ gsum pa tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇḍal gyi khrid la/ sngon 'gro sgrub pa'i maṇḍal dang*/ dngos gzhi mchod pa'i maṇḍal gnyis las/ sngon 'gro sgrub pa'i maṇḍal ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar ri rab gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa'i steng du/ padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i dbus su seng ges btegs pa'i khrir bla ma/ shar du yi dam/ lhor sangs rgyas/ nub tu chos/ byang du dge 'dun/ gong bzhin du gsal btab bo// gnyis pa mchod pa'i maṇḍal ni/ oṃ badzra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ ba'i lci ba'am dri bzang gi chus sa'i phyogs byug par bya'o/

de nas dbus su me tog bzhag ste/ oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod nas byin gyis brlab par bya'o// de nas sngags brjod cing tshom bu bkod pa gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ rin po che sna bdun/ gter chen po'i bum pa dang brgyad/ ri rab nyi zla dang bcas pa rin po che sna tshogs kyis gang ba 'bul bar bya'o/ phan yon ni/ dpag tu med pa yod de/ dze tā ris/ ba yi lci ba chur bcas sbyin pa ste/ legs par byug par byed pa tshul khrims so// srin dang grog sbur bsal ba bzod pa yin/ bya ba la ni nyer zhugs brtson 'grus te/ de la skad cig sems ni gcig byed pa/ bsam gtan shes rab ri mo gsal ba'o// thub pa'i maṇḍal byas pa yis/ pha rol phyin pa 'di drug thob/ ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs shing*/ chos rjes/ zhing khams kyi rten 'brel thams cad 'di la yod par yang gsungs so// de nas sems (47)bskyed pa dang ldan pa rten gyi stobs/ sngar byas la 'gyod pa rnam par sun 'byin/ phyis mi byed par sdom pa sdig pa las slar log /byang chub kyi ltung ba bshags pa'i mdo la sogs pa'i bshags pa'i tshig gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs te bzhis bdag gzhan gyis sdig pa thams cad bshags pa dang*/ dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ sangs rgyas nas ring por ma lon pa rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang*/ mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa rnams mi 'da' bar gsol ba dang*/ de dag gi dge ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bgyis nas/ tshogs zhing sngar bzhin bdag nyid la bsdu'o/// /bzhi pa byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid ni/ rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lta bu'i lha gang mos par bsam pa'i spyi bor gyad dang seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri dar gyis klubs pa/ padma zla nyi brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po dang tha mi dad pa gsal btang pa'i spyi bor/

brgyud pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang la thug gi bar tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa/ de thams cad ngo bo chos nyid dag pa'i klong du gcig pa/ rnam pa gang la gang 'dul gyi gzugs kyi skur shar bas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma nas rdo rje 'chang gi bar/ dgongs pa la mtho dma' dang*/ thugs rje la bri gang med pa/ sangs rgyas nyag gcig tu bzhugs par bsams nas/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byas/ bla ma 'og ma 'og ma'i gdung shugs kyis gong ma gong ma rim pa bzhin zhu nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ bla ma'i smin mtshams nas 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang gi smin mtshams nas zhugs lus thams cad gang*/ lus kyi dri ma dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ (48)lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas/ mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ mgrin par zhugs/ lus gang*/ ngag gi dri ma dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ lam rtsa rlung thig le bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ rang gi snying gar bzhugs/ lus thams cad gang*/ yid kyi dri ma dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas/ bla ma'i gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ rang gi gnas gsum nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang*/ lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag /dbang bzhi pa thob/ lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas/ mthar bla ma gdan khri dang bcas pa rang la thim par bsam mo// de ltar khrid mtha' dag gi sngon du 'gro ba'i yi ge 'di yang*/ padma dkar pos lha btsun gzhan phan bzang por gdams pa'o/// /
